first_deploy_dodaf_mock_2793ee4.reply: USS Essex delivered HADR supplies to Hachinohe by helicopter and, with USS Ronald Reagan, also delivered supplies there via helicopter; USS Essex also delivered blankets and water to Miyako by helicopter.
